name: hud_ui_mgr_destroy_sensor_window
description: HudUiMgr::DestroySensorWindow tears down the active PiV sensor FMV playback and destroys the sensor window.
known_limits: VC5SP3 COFF byte comparison compiles but currently fails with 6 unmasked bytes in the second playback-pointer reload/delete scheduling block; tier S acceptance remains deferred.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly and decompilation for 0x413730 validate the null early return, StopAndClose on g_HudUiSensorWindowPlayback, reloading the global before destructor/delete, clearing g_HudUiSensorWindowPlayback, and calling CWnd::DestroyWindow on g_HudUiSensorWindow.
The direct zFMV_Playback dependencies 0x4624f0 StopAndClose and 0x462360 Destructor are functionally accepted; operator delete is an accepted provider boundary.

The null smoke verifies the early return path. The playback smoke patches mciSendCommandA, allocates a zFMV_Playback object, verifies the stop and close MCI commands and close-parameter playback pointer, and verifies the global is cleared after DestroySensorWindow deletes the playback.
